premise: The dedicated old Android phone is a first-class always-recoverable BCP node, not a passive client or narrow Telegram proxy.

transport_ladder.purpose: PC-to-phone control path without shared LAN; phone may keep independent uplink
high-bandwidth direct PC-phone path while phone keeps another uplink where platform allows
optional wired fallback when hardware/OEM supports it

data_saving_model.goal: PC does not need general Internet access for BCP control-plane traffic when a phone gateway path is available.

dedicated_device_option.rationale: A fully dedicated device can optionally be provisioned as Android Device Owner/DPC for stronger kiosk/restart/policy control, but this is a separate explicit provisioning gate because normal Device Owner enrollment can require factory-reset/unprovisioned-device state.

field_truth_rules: CI/emulator proves software paths, not real radio/OEM behavior.
Wi-Fi Direct/BLE/USB capabilities must be probed on the real old phone before promotion.
No user retry is requested until the exact path is representative-simulated when technically feasible.
